name: ricestat
expr: [m_s, v_s] = ricestat(2, 1); [m_v, v_v] = ricestat([0 1 2], 1); [m_b, v_b] = ricestat(2, [0.5 1 2]); [m_s0, v_s0] = ricestat(0, 1); m_sig0 = ricestat(2, 0); m_sneg = ricestat(-1, 1); m_signeg = ricestat(2, -1);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = ricestat(s, sigma). Rician (Rice). s=0 reduces to Rayleigh: m = sigma·sqrt(π/2), v = sigma²·(2 - π/2). Vectorised. sigma<=0 / s<0 => NaN. MATLAB R2025b doesn't ship ricestat — Octave statistics package is the reference.
